hardWords.m: when a wrong is let go
to laugh at someone in a bad way

paragraphs.text: After Hajj, ask Allah for forgiveness. Remember Allah very much. Some people ask only for this world. They get nothing in the Hereafter. Others ask for good in both lives. They will get what they earned. Leaving after two or three days is no sin. You will all return to Allah.
Some people say sweet words, but they are enemies. They spread harm and destroy crops. Allah does not like this. Others give themselves to please Allah.
Believers, enter Islam fully. Do not follow Satan. He is your clear enemy. Disbelievers love this world. They mock believers.

People were once one group. Allah sent prophets and the Book. He guided the believers to the truth. People before you faced hard tests. Allah's help is near. Spend on parents, relatives, orphans, the poor and travelers. Allah knows the good you do.

title: Remembering Allah, True Faith and Spending
